set.reason: The page names both path parameters `{id}`: first the user, then the customer. Two parameters with one name can't carry two values.
The `status` and `status_faturamento` filters go in the query string, where the text 2 and the number 2 are the same. The pages declare only a number.
The prose of the orders page says `status_custom` takes several values: `?status_custom=0&status_custom=4`. The schema declares one string.
